title: May the odds be ever in your favor: Why we keep returning to Panem
summary: Dystopian fiction has long held a strange yet powerful hold on its audiences. We know the worlds are bleak, the governments are terrifying, and survival is unlikely. And yet, we keep coming back…

blocks.text: Dystopian fiction has long held a strange yet powerful hold on its audiences. We know the worlds are bleak, the governments are terrifying, and survival is unlikely. And yet, we keep coming back anyway–especially to the world of Panem. With ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ set to hit theaters on November 20, the franchise revisits its dystopia through the eyes of a young Haymitch Abernathy, long before he became the cynical mentor fans first met in earlier films But what is it about the universe of ‘The Hunger Games’ that keeps pulling us back?
